author: clonedemned
quote: While the open world and visuals are impressive, although locked to 30 fps, the forced relationship dynamics between the main characters completely ruined the game for me. Certain interactions feel overly intrusive and push boundaries in a way that made me genuinely uncomfortable to play.Instead of feeling like I had freedom over my character, the game frequently forces you into awkward, unwanted domestic scenarios and interactions that kill the pacing. If you are looking for the classic, carefree sandbox experience of past titles, the heavy-handed focus on this relationship makes it hard to enjoy.
